versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update: v2 adds new features, improves usability, and enhances CI support.

- Adds create, validate, and self-test commands for managing and testing templates.
- Supports validation, import/export, JSON output, and versioned templates.
- Revamps documentation; clearer usage examples and CI integration guide.
- Removes obsolete files and refines the template management workflow.
